content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra, then analyze peaks for methyl signals (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon (~10-30 ppm). Since we don't know the compound, we need to get data. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed). Then parse. Let's call tool.
